verdict.rationale: PostHog docs explicitly state dashboards can be assembled, shared, and alerts set 'on the numbers that matter' and insights get you 'alerted when they move' (posthog-docs-3, posthog-docs-25), directly supporting subscribe-and-alert-on-anomaly behavior. However, there's no evidence detailing subscription mechanics, alert configuration granularity, or anomaly-detection sophistication, and no community validation of this specific feature working well.
